description: Single registry of every Tauri project in the monorepo: first-party apps and plugins, workspace-excluded or git-ignored ones, and upstream-owned fixtures. `bun run tauri:apps:check` scans the whole tree (git-ignored and workspace-excluded paths included, only target/node_modules/.git are skipped) and fails on any Tauri project missing here. tauri-sync derives its cargo gate and generated-file list from this file.

projects.note: Desktop agent console. Embeds the prebuilt ui-dist bundle until @aphrody/app-ui joins the workspace.
Koharu desktop shell; the only CEF runtime consumer. Frontend: apps/koharu/editor (@aphrody/koharu-editor-example).
Koharu application library (commands, specta bindings) linked by the koharu binary.
Tauri plugin: Drive daemon commands for aphrody-app.
Native MCP adapter for Tauri webview inspection; no tauri crate dependency.
@koharu/bridge: wasm canvas bridge and Tauri IPC bindings (@tauri-apps/api via catalog).
@koharu/sdk: headless Koharu SDK with the ./tauri entry.
@koharu/ui: Koharu UI components (@tauri-apps/api, plugin-opener via catalog).
@aphrody/koharu-editor-example: static Next.js export (out/) embedded by the koharu app.

@aphrody/scaffold: the single scaffolder (Tauri 3 shell, web/app/example templates, no-overwrite writer). Owns TAURI_3, mirrored from the root pins (config/tauri-upstream.json mirrors); m3 new, m3-next-migrate and web-to-tauri write through it.
@aphrody/web-to-tauri: probes a site or project, plans remote/bundle/sidecar, generates a Tauri 3 project around aphrody-tauri-wrap and checks parity against the original.

Runtime plugin of web-to-tauri: navigation policy, downloads, loopback server with backend proxy (feature bundle, default), sidecar (std only). Reads src-tauri/wrap.json; shares policy-cases.json with the TypeScript policy. Also hosts the feature-gated (debug-bridge) Tauri 3 debug bridge aphrody_tauri_wrap::debug for aphrody-web and aphrody-tauri-mcp: wraps the patched upstream tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge (patches/tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge-0.13.0-tauri3.patch); loopback, per-process token, 0600 discovery file, debug builds only. Enabled in aphrody-model-view through its debug-bridge feature.
Migrates Next.js projects to Tauri 3 apps. Writes them through @aphrody/scaffold (the single scaffolder); TAURI_3 is re-exported from there.
buildM3 / M3App Tauri webview layout; no Tauri dependency.
Upstream Tauri MCP server, bridge plugin (tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge) and test-app fixture. Upstream workspace, kept apart.
Upstream WebDriver plugin and examples/tauri-app fixture.
Upstream Tauri verification toolkit: plugin, test client and demo/gauntlet fixtures.
Vendored tauri-plugin-dialog 3.0.0-alpha.2 with the Manager import fix (see config/tauri-upstream.json patches).
Upstream WebDriver server for Tauri apps.
